instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\twin_fixture.step. Create identical Face and 2D Contour operations for the two identical parts in the fixture. Use separate WCS offsets for the two parts, G54 and G55 or Fusion-equivalent offsets. Tool definition: T1 is an end mill used for the repeated face and contour operations on both WCS offsets. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-13.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
